description:
The Weave line makes it and the clinic fits it, and in between there is a walk across a campus that nobody senior has ever had to make.

The tray is cold. It must stay cold. Vess thanks you for it with the exact warmth she would give a machine that had performed correctly — which is real warmth, delivered accurately, and somehow worse for both of those things.
name: Cold Chain

objectives.desc: Collect the tray from the fabrication line.
emotes: {who} takes the tray in both hands, the way they were shown, once.
{who} feels the cold come up through the handles and quickens their pace without deciding to.
{who} sets the tray down and somebody takes it without looking up.
{who} waits half a second for something, and then goes.
